answer: The zephyr holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
